inputs.text: The International Olympic Committee has finally stopped caving to pressure and made the right call to ban transgender women and DSD athletes from the women's category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and beyond. IOC president Kirsty Coventry put it plainly when she said it would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category. This protects the fairness and safety of women's sports by recognizing biological reality over ideology. For too long progressive ideas have eroded the natural order and traditional structures, and this is a step toward restoring order through personal responsibility and respect for cultural continuity.
